title: Сплетни (Трансформация в 3-е лицо)
description: Перескажи факты о друге (He/She...): преврати предложения от I в рассказ о нём.

items.sentence: I don't like waking up early. → He ___ waking up early.
I spend all my pocket money on snacks. → He ___ all his pocket money on snacks.
I always help my parents. → He always ___ his parents.
I don't do my homework on Fridays. → He ___ his homework on Fridays.
I chat with my friends online. → He ___ with his friends online.
I don't eat meat. → He ___ meat.
I dream of becoming a blogger. → He ___ of becoming a blogger.
